title: Day 1: Foundations
summary: Everything built on day one: the builder graph, the AgentSpec contract, observability, the Postgres event store, the Control Room and the server setup. Plus the plan for the feedback loop: how to evaluate agents so they keep getting better.

title: Day 2: Architecture
summary: How ForgeOne is organised as a long-lived product: the package map and dependency rules, agents in their own repositories (VoyagerOne), how a build is published, the evaluation architecture (suites, checks, scorecards, promotion gate), versioned migrations and the server changes.

title: Day 3: Improvements
summary: Explained for newcomers: goals broken into milestones, tasks and actions; the stages every task goes through (execute, verify, edge test, approve) and how failures feed the next attempt; sign-offs and go-aheads; agents that really run with browser tools; building an agent as a goal with a playbook; where it is all stored, and how it turns into knowledge about which model works for which task.
